name: lectio-api-mcp
description: Access Lectio API lectionary readings, liturgical calendar, tradition metadata, and search through MCP tools, resources, and prompts.
long_description: A Model Context Protocol server for Lectio API. Canonical tools are get_readings, get_calendar, list_traditions, and search_lectionary. explore_calendar and analyze_liturgical_context remain as one-release aliases. Hosted Streamable HTTP lives at https://lectio-api.org/mcp.

tools.name: get_readings
tools.description: Readings for today, a YYYY-MM-DD date, or a date range.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Season, cycle, year, feast lookup, upcoming holy days, or factual context for a date.

tools.name: list_traditions
tools.description: Metadata for rcl, catholic, episcopal, and bcp.

tools.name: search_lectionary
tools.description: Search readings by season or feast name.

api_url.title: Lectionary API URL
api_url.description: Base URL for the Lectionary API.
